title: Output Schema for Poll Operation
description: Output schema for the Solace poll operation.

payload.description: On a successful poll, the polled message content (JSON replies are parsed into an object or array; non-JSON content is surfaced as a string). On timeout, a JSON envelope of the form {"received": false, "timedOut": true, "destination": "<queue>"}. Inspect attributes.received / attributes.timedOut before dereferencing.

attributes.description: Metadata about the poll operation and, when a message was received, the polled message.

destination.description: The name of the queue that was polled.

received.description: Whether a message was received before the poll timed out.

timedOut.description: Whether the poll timed out without receiving a message.

ackMode.description: AUTO when the flow owner acknowledged the message right after handing it to this call. CLIENT when the message is stashed under solace.poll.message for acknowledgeMessage or nackMessage with target=POLL. Absent inside a transaction, where commit or rollback settles the message.

leaseDeadline.description: Epoch time in milliseconds at which the connector settles an unsettled CLIENT lease FAILED, so the broker redelivers the message. Present only for ackMode=CLIENT when a message was received.

contentType.description: The content type of the polled message payload (e.g., application/json, application/xml, text/plain). Present only when a message was received.

correlationId.description: The correlation id of the message.

senderId.description: The sender id of the message.

deliveryMode.description: The delivery mode of the message (e.g., DIRECT, PERSISTENT, NON_PERSISTENT).

redelivered.description: Whether the message was flagged as redelivered by the broker.

dmqEligible.description: Whether the message is eligible for the Dead Message Queue.

elidingEligible.description: Whether the message is eligible for eliding.

expiration.description: Absolute message expiration time as a UTC epoch in milliseconds. Present only when non-zero.

timeToLive.description: Time to live in milliseconds. Present only when non-zero.

senderTimestamp.description: Sender-supplied timestamp as a UTC epoch in milliseconds. Present only when set.

receiveTimestamp.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when the message was received. Present only when non-zero.

sequenceNumber.description: The publisher-assigned sequence number. Present only when set.

replyTo.description: The reply-to destination of the message, when present.

type.description: The reply-to destination type (TOPIC or QUEUE).

userProperties.description: Publisher-supplied user properties carried on the message, for content-based routing and filtering.

headers.description: Transport headers associated with the response.
